provider_baseline.pricing_note: Official RunPod rate card observed RTX 5090 Secure USD 0.99/h and RTX Pro 6000 Secure USD 2.09/h; recheck live price/availability immediately before any launch.

stages.purpose: setup + image candidates + low-VRAM video viability + initial throughput
measure reduced-offload benefit, high-VRAM video candidates and model-switch overhead

stages.gpu: finalist tier, worst-case costed as RTX Pro 6000
stages.purpose: repeat fixed finalist population and stability profile before purchase decision

prelaunch_gates: recheck live GPU rate and availability
all selected models have exact source revision and acceptable evaluation license
benchmark run is dry-run clean and reference requirements are satisfied
provider all-in projected charge including taxes/fees if shown does not exceed USD 150
explicit bounded spend approval is present
stop_conditions: projected all-in provider charge would exceed USD 150
runtime cannot reproduce smoke population after 2 setup attempts
OOM/failure prevents meaningful measurement for the tier
artifact/evidence download cannot be verified before instance termination

data_policy.upload: slice01 benchmark-only, no secrets, no unlicensed source material
data_policy.secrets: ephemeral dedicated credentials only if required; never repo secrets
data_policy.cleanup: terminate rented compute and remove temporary provider storage after verified download

initial_execution_subcap_note: If paid execution is later explicitly approved, first launch batch must remain within USD 60; the USD 150 envelope is a proposal ceiling for all three stages, not standing spend authority.
